description_html:
A one bedroom penthouse on the 7th floor with a larger balcony and space for planting and a small table and chairs. The kitchen has been refurbished by Thomson Brothers. There is a good sized hallway with additional fitted storage, an original Barbican bathroom with fitted storage, a larger than average bedroom with a fitted wardrobe and a full height window. The reception room has a full height window with a sliding door to the balcony.

The Barbican estate offers on- site amenities including the Arts Centre with its Cafés, Restaurants, Theatres, Library and Cinemas, and use of the residents private gardens. The car parks benefit from 24 hour porterage, and all flats have underfloor background heating included within the service charge.

A Waitrose supermarket is available on nearby Whitecross Street, a Marks and Spencer food and clothing store and a number of five star hotels.

As of Autumn 2001 the Barbican Estate became Grade II listed.

Willoughby House is conveniently located close to Moorgate and Liverpool Street station with access to the Elizabeth line.

Tenure: Leasehold Lease Years Remaining: 170
Service Charge: £6,416 (Yearly)
Annual Ground Rent: £10
Council Tax Band: E
